purpose: determine whether the newly translated diffusion-Q1 Top-2 cohort earns early enough to justify one shorter-capital-cycle strategy test
frozen_domain: exact intensity_bucket 1 executed trades already used by the causal Top-2 replay
required_views: full mean median winner and severe-loss fraction
incremental payoff d1-d3, d3-d5, d5-d10, d10-d15, d15-d20
mean payoff retained relative to d20
mean payoff per held session as a descriptive capital-speed diagnostic

interpretation.EARLY_MATURATION: a shorter existing checkpoint retains a substantial majority of d20 payoff, is positive in both blocks, improves tail risk, and does not rely on one year
interpretation.FULL_HORIZON_REQUIRED: material payoff continues to accrue through d20 or earlier checkpoints are chronologically unstable
interpretation.NO_CLEAR_LIFECYCLE_EDGE: no checkpoint provides a coherent payoff-speed and risk tradeoff

prohibited: new checkpoints or intraday exit search
stop, take-profit, trailing exit, market filter, or signal change
